mapper.select: select id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, create_time, update_time from user_address where user_id = #{userId} order by is_default desc, id desc

select id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, create_time, update_time from user_address where user_id = #{userId} and is_default = 1 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into user_address(user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, create_time, update_time) values(#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update user_address set receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, district = #{district}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, is_default = #{isDefault}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from user_address where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update user_address set is_default = 0, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
update user_address set is_default = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}

mapper.insert: insert into user_favorite(user_id, goods_id, create_time) values(#{userId}, #{goodsId}, now())
